rv.q: Duff’s clunky direction and the lack of narrative drive make this a piece of theatre that is essentially a nostalgic victory lap for the creators and fans – and not a great deal for anyone else.
Ideal’s 20th Anniversary Live Show is a laugh out loud riot of a theatre show that fans both old and new can feel at home while watching.
The infatuating cast and inventive skits make for an undeniably hilarious evening, albeit one with a tad too many technical difficulties.

cn.t: The cult sitcom's stage adaptation delights fans with its original cast and dark humor, though critics warn newcomers may struggle to connect without prior knowledge of the beloved BBC series.
